The problem

Three failures. One unused fix.

Problem one  ·  Pharmacy economics

Pharmacy margins
are collapsing.

The downstream effect

Pharmacies across the US are closing — displacing communities and unemploying clinically valuable pharmacists.

02

Patients deteriorate
between visits.

The downstream effect

Chronic conditions worsen unchecked — driving preventable hospitalizations, readmissions, and early mortality.

03
Problem three  ·  Clinical data

Clinical data
stays siloed.

The downstream effect

Drug development stays slow and costly — real-world outcomes never reach the researchers who need them.

The Pharmacy

The solution

Scriptify is a telemedicine clinic embedded into community pharmacies — evolving their operations beyond dispensing into robust clinics for chronic patients that turn every prescription into a longitudinal data point.

Value prop · A  ·  The clinic layer

Pharmacies are the distribution channel
for telemedicine chronic care.

We're not inventing a new payment rail — we're activating one that already exists. CDTM and chronic care reimbursement has been on the books for a decade. No one has built the pharmacy-embedded clinic that fully unlocks it.

Key Stakeholders
Patients
Better outcomes.
Continuous chronic care between visits. Fewer hospitalizations, stronger adherence, longer lives.
Pharmacies
New revenue.
Clinical reimbursement on top of dispensing — plus higher refill capture from enrolled chronic patients.
Payers
Cost savings.
Fewer readmissions, fewer ED visits, measurable reduction in the most expensive line items on the insurance P&L.
Value prop · B  ·  The data layer

Every prescription becomes a
longitudinal clinical data point.

The same patients we care for generate the richest, most structured real-world evidence dataset in chronic disease — compounding with every pharmacy added to the network.

Key Stakeholders
Pharma & CROs
Trial recruitment.
Structured chronic-disease cohorts, ready to enroll — compressing trial timelines and patient-identification costs.
Insurance Companies
Formulary design.
Real-world adherence and outcomes data for tiered formulary construction and coverage decisions.
Big Pharma
RWE & RWD.
Post-market surveillance, label-expansion evidence, real-world comparators — the modern FDA-grade data currency.
